title: Quick Crispy Thai Vegetable Nam Prik
description: A resinous and crispy solo dinner Thai dish featuring ground coriander, this plant-based friendly nam prik is slow-cooked to perfection. It is a classic Isaan dish with a twist.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the chopped Thai bird eye chilies and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cut eggplant and bell pepper, and cook until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a small bowl, mix together the toasted ground coriander, salt, peanut butter, and lime juice.
Pour the coriander mixture over the vegetables and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the nam prik for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and the vegetables are coated.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let the nam prik cool to room temperature.
Serve the nam prik warm or at room temperature, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
